name: SigNoz
description: SigNoz Cloud's hosted server queries logs, traces, metrics and alerts (US region).

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.us.signoz.cloud) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
